name: Mannat: Harr Khushi Paane Ki
description: Abandoned at birth, Mannat grows up to be a talented chef, unaware that her boss, is her biological mother. As love, betrayal, and secrets collide, Mannat must decide if her dreams and resilience can help her overcome the storm and find her destiny.

videos.title: Mannat: a Dreamer With a Flame!
videos.overview: Shruti saves a newborn, naming her Mannat. Twenty-three years on, Mannat's ambition as a chef intertwines with a hidden past.

videos.title: Mannat's Special Day
videos.overview: Mannat's birthday celebration, planned by Mallika, is interrupted by a storm. Vikrant's support creates a unique bond. Will this day forge lasting friendships?

videos.title: Mannat's Helpless Situation
videos.overview: Delayed at a temple, Mannat needs a Mumbai lifeline. Vikrant steps in, but can she trust his late-night offer?

videos.title: Mallika Infuriates Shruti
videos.overview: A party invitation sparks conflict: Mallika's attempts to secure Mannat's attendance anger Shruti, leading to her dismissal. Can Mannat change Shruti's mind about Mallika?

videos.title: Mannat Learns The Hard Truth
videos.overview: A party descends into chaos as Mannat is harassed. Vikrant intervenes, but Mannat's world shatters with her mother's illness. Will she find the strength to endure?

videos.title: Mannat's Shocking Discovery
videos.overview: Mannat plans to donate her liver, but Shruti's desperate attempts to stop her reveal a family secret. Will Mannat forgive the deception?

videos.title: Mannat's Unwavering Love!
videos.overview: Accepting the truth of her parentage, Mannat visits the hospital and assures her mother that she will continue to love her, even though she is not her biological mother.

videos.title: Vikrant Puts Mallika On The Spot!
videos.overview: To evade her mother's anger, Mallika tries to place the blame for the restaurant fiasco on the staff. However, Vikrant stands up for the staff, suggesting Mallika's culpability.

videos.title: Mannat's Risky Plan
videos.overview: Mannat attempts to sneak out for her interview but encounters Aish patrolling the house. However, Mallika devises a plan to help Mannat escape.

videos.title: Aish Discovers Mannat's Truth
videos.overview: Mannat feels ecstatic as she successfully clears the first round of her interview. Meanwhile, Aish notices Mannat's bracelet and follows her to uncover her true background.

videos.title: Aish Confronts Mallika
videos.overview: Aish accuses Mallika of being emotionally weak and claims Mannat is exploiting her for fame and money. Can Mallika prove her mother wrong?

videos.title: Mannat Makes a Vow
videos.overview: Mannat vows to prove herself after failing the kitchen test, determined to become a great chef. Later, she is informed that her liver is not a good match for donation.

videos.title: Vikrant's Secret Plan
videos.overview: As per Vikrant's plan, Mallika suggests to Aish organising a party to welcome Vikrant's parents. Later, Mallika accompanies Vikrant to Mannat's home to introduce him to her.

videos.title: Vikrant Hires Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant asks Mannat to prepare food for his parents at their welcome party, saying it's her one chance to showcase her talent and secure a job at his restaurant.

videos.title: Mannat Faces a Disaster
videos.overview: As Mannat and her team prepare a feast for Vikrant's parents, Mallika enters the kitchen to shoot videos and accidentally ruins the cake. How will Mannat fix the situation?

videos.title: Mannat Impresses Everyone
videos.overview: Mannat quickly crafts a new dessert for dinner, impressing Vikrant's parents and Aish with her skill. However, Aish is surprised to learn that Mannat prepared the food.

videos.title: Aish Brings Mannat Onboard
videos.overview: Shruti is stunned to discover that Aish is Sonia. Aish seethes with rage as Mallika's request forces her to hire Mannat. Will Shruti let Mannat work under Aish?

videos.title: Shruti Warns Mannat!
videos.overview: While Shruti holds back from telling Mannat that Aish is her mother, she cautions her against accepting Aish's job offer. Will Mannat heed her warning?

videos.title: Mannat Feels Optimistic
videos.overview: Mannat is thrilled and hopeful as she prepares for her first day at work, while Puneet schemes to cause trouble for her upon her arrival. Will he succeed in his evil aim?

videos.title: Aish to Ruin Mannat's Dreams
videos.overview: While Puneet troubles Mannat at work, she remains determined to fulfil her duties. Noticing Mannat's ambition, Aish grows furious and vows to shatter her dreams.

videos.title: Aish's Sinister Plan
videos.overview: While Vikrant prepares to welcome the food inspector, Aish secretly spikes Mannat's coffee to create trouble. As the inspection progresses, Mannat begins to behave strangely.

videos.title: Mannat Causes a Scene
videos.overview: Aish's plan succeeds as an intoxicated Mannat causes a scene before Mrs Barman. Vikrant is ashamed of Mannat's behaviour and ejects her from Mezbaani.

videos.title: Puneet Suspects Aishwarya's Actions
videos.overview: Puneet suspects Aishwarya after noticing her behaviour following the shocking incident at Mezbaani. Mallika advises Mannat to apologise to Vikrant for her mistakes.

videos.title: Vikrant Takes The Heat!
videos.overview: Vikrant faces Puneet's wrath for the chaos Mannat created. Meanwhile, Mannat sets out to find the proof she needs to clear her name. Will she succeed in uncovering the truth?

videos.title: Mannat Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Mannat finds a discarded bottle of cheap liquor and traces it to the shop where it was bought. She discovers Aish purchased it but chooses to keep it from Mallika.

videos.title: Mannat's Desperate Attempt
videos.overview: Mannat eagerly visits Mrs Barman's office and waits to convince her to approve. Later, Aish emotionally manipulates Vikrant into agreeing to open the restaurant in Singapore.

videos.title: Mannat to Impress Mrs Barman
videos.overview: Aishwarya informs the media about the chaos at Saluja's restaurant and the cancellation of its food license. Wanting to impress Mrs. Barman, Mannat prepares a French dish.

videos.title: Mannat Secures Second Chance!
videos.overview: Thanks to Mannat's persistence, Mrs. Burman agrees to a second inspection rather than cancelling Vikrant's restaurant. How will Vikrant react to this news?

videos.title: Aish Questions Mannat
videos.overview: Furious to see Mannat back in the restaurant kitchen, Aish tries to force her out. But Mannat stands her ground, revealing she knows who tried to frame her.

videos.title: Mannat Gives a Brilliant Idea!
videos.overview: For Mrs Burman's inspection, Mannat presents a Valentine's Day-themed menu. Vikrant, impressed by the idea, gives his approval. Will they leave a lasting impression on Mrs Burman?

videos.title: Mannat Gets Punished
videos.overview: Puneet is furious at Mannat for using her phone at work and punishes her with extra tasks. Later, she and Vikrant share a lighthearted moment in the kitchen.

videos.title: Mannat Faces a Tragedy
videos.overview: Mannat rushes an unconscious Shruti to the hospital, where the doctor warns her that she must find a donor for Shruti immediately. Can Mannat save Shruti?

videos.title: Mannat Searches For Sonia
videos.overview: Mannat learns that Shruti is desperately searching for her sister, Sonia, and decides to help. However, she is unaware that Sonia has changed her name to Aishwarya.

videos.title: Vikrant Rejects Mallika
videos.overview: Vikrant and Mallika are shocked when Aishwarya unexpectedly announces their engagement to the media. However, Vikrant dismisses the press and firmly refuses to marry Mallika.

videos.title: Mallika Rebukes Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat helps Vikrant realise his mistake in lashing out at Mallika, but Mallika misinterprets their closeness. Later, she accuses Mannat of trying to woo Vikrant.

videos.title: Aish's Ruthless Attack
videos.overview: Vikrant confronts Aish, insisting that he has no feelings for Mallika. Aish viciously attacks Mannat and traps her inside the cold storage. What fate awaits Mannat?

videos.title: Race Against Time
videos.overview: On Shivratri, Mannat regains consciousness but struggles to open the freezer. Vikrant reaches the godown, while a tense Aish fears being caught.

videos.title: Vikrant Rescues Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant rescues Mannat and takes her home, leaving Aish anxious about being exposed. Meanwhile, Shruti arrives at the Saluja house in disguise and comes face to face with Aish.

videos.title: Vikrant Hits Puneet
videos.overview: Mannat tells Vikrant that Puneet called her early in the morning. Enraged, Vikrant confronts Puneet and hits him for trying to harm her.

videos.title: A Photo Unveils The Truth
videos.overview: Mannat apologizes to Puneet for missing his message. Later, she finds a photo of the fake mother planted by Shruti and realizes the woman has passed away.

videos.title: Aish Faces Her Past
videos.overview: On Women's Day, Aish discovers that the daughter she abandoned 23 years ago is alive.

videos.title: Shruti Threatens Aish
videos.overview: Shruti warns Aish to stay away from her family or she will reveal her secret. Meanwhile, Mannat refuses to attend the Holi party.

videos.title: Vikrant is Smitten By Mannat
videos.overview: Everyone arrives at the Holi celebration venue, where a romantic moment unfolds between Mannat and Vikrant.

videos.title: Holika Dahan Celebrations
videos.overview: Holika Dahan celebrations begin as Mannat stuns everyone in Aish's saree. Meanwhile, Aish reaches Shruti's chawl and is about to set her house on fire.

videos.title: Aish Sets Shruti's House On Fire
videos.overview: Aish sets Shruti's house on fire. Vikrant gets glimpses of his past and feels disturbed. Mannat rushes to help.

videos.title: Aish Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Shruti gets burnt, and Mannat rushes to save her. Aish discovers that Mannat is the daughter she had abandoned.

videos.title: Mannat is Left Homeless
videos.overview: Shruti fights for her life in the ICU, while Mannat gets ousted from her chawl. Vikrant steps in to support her.

videos.title: Aish Fails, Mannat Fights
videos.overview: Aish tries to kill Shruti but fails as Vikrant arrives. Mannat returns to work, needing money for Shruti’s treatment.

videos.title: Goons Attack Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat is attacked by goons, but Vikrant arrives just in time to save her. Will this incident bring them closer or create new complications?

videos.title: Mannat Enters The Lioness's Den
videos.overview: Vikrant brings Mannat to the Saluja residence, but Aish, furious, forces her to stay as staff in the outhouse. Will Mannat tolerate this humiliation or fight back?

videos.title: Mannat Discovers The Truth
videos.overview: Mannat discovers that Shruti deceived her by introducing a fake mother to stop her from finding her real one.

videos.title: Aish is Scared
videos.overview: Mannat requests leave to investigate Sonia Khanna, leaving Aish shocked because she is Sonia Khanna.

videos.title: Aish Traps Mannat
videos.overview: Aish traps Mannat in the plane's washroom to reach Ambala School before Mannat and Vikrant.

videos.title: Aish Misleads Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat discovers helper Sunita is actually Sonia Khanna, a deception planned by Aish.

videos.title: Mannat Faces The Truth
videos.overview: Sunita deceives Mannat by claiming to be Sonia Khanna, while Aish feels relieved.

videos.title: Mannat is Framed
videos.overview: Neetu and Raveena falsely accuse Mannat of stealing Raveena's diamond bangle, putting her in a tough spot. Will Mannat be able to prove her innocence?

videos.title: Mannat Proves Her Innocence
videos.overview: Mannat proves her innocence and decides to leave the Saluja house.

videos.title: Vikrant Doesn't Let Mannat Leave
videos.overview: Vikrant demands Mannat clear her debts before leaving, while Bobby sets his sights on her.

videos.title: Shalini is Assaulted
videos.overview: Shalini is assaulted by Bobby. Mannat rescues her and takes her to the hospital.

videos.title: Mannat Confronts Aish
videos.overview: Mannat tells Aish she will not stay silent and will fight for Shalini's justice.

videos.title: Mannat is Heartbroken
videos.overview: Vikrant stands by Mannat in her fight for Shalini’s justice but when Shalini refuses to speak up, Mannat is left heartbroken.

videos.title: Mannat Speaks The Truth
videos.overview: When confronted by the press, Mannat reveals that Shalini was molested at Mezbaani, leaving Aish furious.

videos.title: Vikrant Snaps At Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant, shattered by Mezbaani’s scandal, blames Mannat for involving the press, while she fights to prove her innocence.

videos.title: Mannat is Shattered
videos.overview: Mannat is upset as Sunita’s liver doesn’t match Shruti’s. Aish gets Derrick arrested for assaulting Shalini.

videos.title: Shalini's Fear Raises Doubts
videos.overview: Shalini panics after seeing Bobby on TV, and Mannat notices. She tells Vikrant that Derrick might not be the real culprit.

videos.title: Mannat Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Mannat realises Bobby molested Shalini and secretly steals his passport to stop him from fleeing the country.

videos.title: Vikrant Lashes Out At Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat reveals Bobby is the culprit but the Salujas don’t believe her. Vikrant loses his cool and lashes out at her.

videos.title: Mannat Loses Her Job
videos.overview: Mannat resigns to fight for Shalini's justice. Aish demands Mannat repay the 20K she owes before leaving.

videos.title: Mannat Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Aish gets Mannat arrested for slandering the Saluja name by circulating a video to the media accusing Bobby of being the culprit.

videos.title: Mannat is Determined
videos.overview: Bobby kidnaps Shalini's brother, and Mannat vows to rescue him.

videos.title: Will Mannat Succeed?
videos.overview: Mannat rushes to save Aditya but ends up getting captured by Bobby. Will she find a way to escape and rescue Aditya in time?

videos.title: Mannat Rescues Adi
videos.overview: Mannat saves Adi, but Shalini refuses to testify against Bobby. Meanwhile, Aish announces Shalini's engagement to Puneet. How will Shalini handle this situation?

videos.title: Mannat is Heartbroken
videos.overview: Mannat warns Vikrant he’ll be ashamed once truth is out. She secretly sends the blood-stained gold chain for lab testing.

videos.title: Mannat is Humiliated
videos.overview: On Aish's orders, protestors smear black ink on Mannat's face. Mannat wipes it off with Aish's saree, boldly declaring she's not afraid of her.

videos.title: Mannat and Bobby Face to Face
videos.overview: Bobby messages Mannat from Shalini's phone, urging her to meet him. When they finally come face to face, tensions rise. What will happen next between them?

videos.title: Vikrant Supports Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat records Bobby's confession. Vikrant intervenes, saving Mannat from Bobby and reveals to everyone that Bobby is the culprit.

videos.title: Bobby Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Vikrant has Shalini slap Bobby before he's arrested, then apologizes to Mannat for not believing her all this time.

videos.title: Vikrant Stays Adamant
videos.overview: Vikrant convinces Mannat to stay in the outhouse and clashes with Neetu. Meanwhile, Neetu secretly continues giving Vikrant memory loss medication.

videos.title: Proof is Being Stolen
videos.overview: Aish and Malla steal the evidence against Bobby. Later Vikrant falls ill and recalls a bloody childhood memory. Mannat gently comforts him through the pain.

videos.title: Vikrant Misses Court
videos.overview: Mannat gives Vikrant the evidence copy. Neetu slits her wrist after Raveena threatens her. Vikrant fails to reach court on time and Mannat grows anxious.

videos.title: Goons Attack Mannat
videos.overview: Goons sent by Aish attack Mannat and destroy the evidence. Mannat fights back and later confronts Aish in anger.

videos.title: Mannat's Victory
videos.overview: Mannat blackmails Aish to testify against Bobby. Bobby is jailed, and Mannat wins justice for Shalini.

videos.title: Mannat is Suspicious
videos.overview: Mannat gets her job back. Gagan reveals Aish’s secret, saying she paid Sunita to cover it up.

videos.title: Aish is Stressed
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant arrive at Sunita's village, leaving Aish anxious after learning about it from Sunita.

videos.title: Mannat-sunita Come Face to Face
videos.overview: When Vikrant falls unwell, Mannat and the family tend to him. Amid wedding preparations, Mannat comes across Sunita! Will the truth be out?

videos.title: Aish Runs Over Vikrant!
videos.overview: Vikrant and Mannat chase Sunita while Aish ploys to ruin their attempt. Desperate, Aish tries to run Mannat down with her speeding car, but accidentally hits Vikrant.

videos.title: Neetu Slaps Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat gets help from an Ayurveda doctor to treat Vikrant and helps him recover. Later, Neetu slaps Mannat and blames her for everything.

videos.title: Malla is Jealous
videos.overview: As Vikrant recovers, Malla burns with jealousy seeing Mannat by his side. Neetu warns Vikrant to stay away from gold diggers like Mannat.

videos.title: Sunita Threatens Aish
videos.overview: Mannat catches Sunita red handed as she tries to blackmail Aish. With evidence in hand, Mannat confronts Sunita. Will Aish be cleared, or will Sunita manage to turn the tables?

videos.title: Aish Burns Sunita
videos.overview: Mannat helps Anu and Nikhil reconcile. Aish confesses she is Sonia Khanna and sets Sunita on fire to stop her from revealing the truth.

videos.title: Mannat Saves Sunita
videos.overview: Mannat rescues Sunita and brings her to stay at the Saluja outhouse, leaving Aish deeply unsettled and worried about the consequences.

videos.title: Vikrant to Confess His Love to Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant plans to propose to Mannat. Meanwhile, Aish attempts to kill Sunita, but Harneet arrives in time to save her.

videos.title: Malla Spoils Mannat's Cake
videos.overview: Anu's engagement begins. Malla poisons Mannat's cake to make Vikrant angry at her and ruin the event.

videos.title: Vikrant’s Proposal Takes an Unexpected Turn
videos.overview: Aish fails to kill Sunita, but Vikrant accidentally eats the poisoned cake meant for her. While proposing to Mannat, he collapses, leaving everyone in shock.

videos.title: Who is Drugging Vikrant?
videos.overview: Mannat overhears a doctor discussing how Vikrant is being drugged, causing his condition to worsen. Alarmed, she begins her search to uncover the person behind the plot.

videos.title: Mannat On a Mission
videos.overview: Mannat stops Aish from attacking Sunita and takes her place to contact the doctor who knows Vikrant was drugged. She secretly arranges a meeting to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Mannat Questions Neetu
videos.overview: Mannat discovers Neetu has been drugging Vikrant and confronts her in shock. She demands to know why a mother would harm her own son. Neetu is left speechless.

videos.title: Vikrant is Stunned
videos.overview: Keerat exposes Neetu for drugging Vikrant. Vikrant confronts her but Neetu denies it. Mannat lashes out asking how a mother could lie to her own son.

videos.title: Mannat Walks Out On Lies
videos.overview: Neetu emotionally manipulates Vikrant into asking Mannat to apologise. Mannat refuses and decides to leave, unwilling to live in a house built on lies.

videos.title: Aish Blackmails Neetu
videos.overview: Malika tries to stop Mannat, but she leaves determined. Neetu reveals Vikrant’s secret to Aish, who then blackmails Neetu into arranging Malika's marriage to Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat-sunita In Danger!
videos.overview: Malika tries to incite Vikrant against Mannat. The ambulance carrying Mannat and Sunita loses its brakes!

videos.title: A New Revelation Shocks Mannat!
videos.overview: Sunita dies after revealing that Aish knows the identity of Mannat’s real mother. Shocked and heartbroken, Mannat struggles to come to terms with the truth.

videos.title: Vikrant Refuses to Marry Malika
videos.overview: Vikrant refuses Neetu’s demand for Malika's marriage. Meanwhile, Mannat vows to expose Aishwarya’s truth.

videos.title: Mannat is Stunned
videos.overview: Vikrant expresses his desire to be with someone, seemingly proposing to Mannat but leaves her stunned when he addresses Malika instead. Aish and Neetu celebrate with delight.

videos.title: Vikrant Proposes to Malika
videos.overview: Vikrant proposes to Malika and later confronts Mannat about her indifference. He insists that she must help with the wedding preparations.

videos.title: Will Mannat Confess Her Love?
videos.overview: Vikrant and Malika forge a new plan to make Mannat confront her feelings. On Vikrant’s request, Mannat feeds him food and stops him from consuming the juice laced by Neetu.

videos.title: Mannat Plays Her First Card
videos.overview: Mannat’s confession surprises Vikrant, who grows closer to her. Meanwhile, Shalini supports Mannat’s feelings, but Aish senses the brewing romance and plans to intervene.

videos.title: Malla Asks Mannat For a Promise
videos.overview: Vikrant wants Mannat to admit her love but their rift deepens. Malla emotionally manipulates Mannat into promising she will never come between them.

videos.title: Mannat Outwits Neetu
videos.overview: Mannat confronts Vikrant for losing her trust. As Neetu brings juice, Mannat suspects foul play and spoils it to stop Vikrant from unknowingly taking medication.

videos.title: Vikrant Stands By Mannat
videos.overview: Malla’s plan works as Neetu ousts Mannat, but Vikrant stands firm, refusing to marry Malla unless Mannat is allowed to stay in the house.

videos.title: Mannat and Vikrant's Divine Moment
videos.overview: Through divine intervention, Mannat and Vikrant’s chunari chadhana ritual is completed. Meanwhile, Gayatri gives Aishwarya a clever plan to expose Mannat.

videos.title: Aish Traps Mannat
videos.overview: Aish uses fluorescent powder to expose Mannat at the cocktail party, while Vik plans to reveal his wedding with Malla is fake. Will both truths come out?

videos.title: Mannat Outsmarts Aish
videos.overview: Mannat tricks Aish by handing the second threat letter. Aish fails to spot prints and doubts Mannat.

videos.title: Will Aish Fall For Mannat’s Trap?
videos.overview: Mannat smartly lures Aish to the chawl and sets a trap to scare her. Later, Aish confesses the truth.

videos.title: Aish Discovers Mannat's Scheme
videos.overview: Mannat locks Aish in a photo studio, concealing her face with a sack. Though Aish is eventually rescued, she grows suspicious that Mannat is behind the trap.

videos.title: Mannat Fights to Save Vikrant
videos.overview: Mannat discovers Vikrant’s memory lapses and secretly swaps Neetu’s medicines. Meanwhile, Malla plots a plan during her act to separate Vikrant and Mannat.

videos.title: Mannat and Gagan Join Hands
videos.overview: Mannat learns Gagan has been helping her expose Aish, and they unite. During the Mehendi ceremony, Malla lures Mannat to the stage, plotting to burn her alive.

videos.title: Vikrant Saves Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant rescues Mannat from a blast she plotted herself. Aish takes Rs 1 crore and goes to meet a blackmailer, unaware of Gagan following her. Later, Vikrant confronts Mannat.

videos.title: Mannat Comes to Gagan’s Rescue
videos.overview: Aish brings the money but Ravindra’s men catch the blackmailer. Mannat helps Gagan flee with the cash. Malla admits to the blast, but Aish insists the wedding must take off.

videos.title: Vikrant-mannat’s Kaleera Ceremony
videos.overview: Mannat helps the Chawl people with Aish’s money. Neetu plots against Mannat. Later, Vikrant and Mannat’s divine Kaleera ceremony takes place.

videos.title: Mannat to Expose Aish!
videos.overview: Mannat learns Shruti has 24 hours for a liver transplant. She joins Gagan to expose Aish and uncover her real mother. Later, Aish receives a chilling threat during Jagrata.

videos.title: Mannat Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Terrified of dying, Aish confesses to Mannat that she is her biological mother who abandoned her at birth. Mannat demands she donate her liver to save Shruti or be exposed.

videos.title: Mannat Compels Aish to Donate
videos.overview: Mannat threatens Aish to donate her liver to save Shruti or be exposed as Sonia Khanna. Aish agrees, but only if Mannat breaks Vikrant's heart so he marries Malla.

videos.title: Mannat Breaks Vikrant's Heart
videos.overview: To save Shruti, Aish demands Mannat break Vikrant's heart in exchange for her liver. Mannat complies, leaving Vikrant shattered as she asks for a stake in Mezbani.

videos.title: Mannat Sacrifices Her Love
videos.overview: Mannat breaks Vikrant’s heart to get Aish’s consent. Guilt consumes her, while a shattered Vikrant decides to confess everything to Ronny.

videos.title: Mannat Saves Shruti
videos.overview: Mannat feels guilty for hurting Vikrant but is relieved that Shruti's surgery went well. Malla lies about spending the night with Vikrant to trap him into marriage.

videos.title: Mannat Charts a New Path
videos.overview: Mannat plans a fresh start with Shruti, warning Aish to stay away. Aish plots revenge, while Ronny pressures Vikrant to marry Malla after their night together.

videos.title: Mannat Refuses Shruti’s Support
videos.overview: Shruti wants to return to Saluja Mansion seeing Mannat hurt, but Mannat refuses. Aish is thrilled as Mannat’s story ends and Vikrant prepares to marry Malla.

videos.title: Mannat’s Bold Griha Pravesh
videos.overview: Ravindra aims to shoot Mannat, but she boldly performs her grah pravesh. Aish reveals that Mannat owns Mezbani shares. Mannat declares she will live there with dignity.

videos.title: Mannat Faces False Accusations
videos.overview: Vikrant tells Mannat to leave, accusing her of cheating and stealing the property. Mannat stands confident, ready to reveal the truth about Aishwarya.

videos.title: Mannat and Vikrant’s Intense Clash
videos.overview: Mannat learns that Vikrant spent the night with Malla. Tension erupts between them in an intense confrontation, where Vikrant lashes out, accusing Mannat of objectifying him and treating him like a commodity.

videos.title: Malla Gets Furious At Mannat!
videos.overview: At Vikrant and Malla’s reception, their moments are replaced by clips of Vikrant and Mannat. Neetu blames Mannat, and Malla dares her to prove her innocence or face public humiliation.

videos.title: Mannat Proves Her Innocence
videos.overview: Mannat proves her innocence and Vikrant apologizes after learning Neetu staged the AV drama. Malla shocks Neetu by shifting all the blame onto her.

videos.title: Malla Spikes Mannat
videos.overview: Malla spikes Mannat’s brownie, leaving her intoxicated. At the press conference, a disoriented Mannat creates a scene, shocking everyone and angering Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat Nearly Reveals Aish's Secret
videos.overview: Vikrant rescues Mannat from a wardrobe mishap at the press conference. Just as Mannat is about to reveal Aish's condition for the liver donation, Aish intervenes in time.

videos.title: Mannat Discovers The Truth
videos.overview: Mannat learns Malla faked sleeping with Vikrant to emotionally trap him into marriage. Determined, Mannat decides to win Vikrant back.

videos.title: Mannat Saves Vikrant
videos.overview: Malla plans to drug Vikrant at the farmhouse, but Mannat outsmarts her. Later, she vows to protect Vikrant and won’t let any harm come to him.

videos.title: Malla’s Scheme to Bring Vikrant Home
videos.overview: Malla misbehaves with Vikrant, but Mannat stands up for him. Later, Malla electrocutes Neetu to lure Vikrant home and separate him from Mannat.

videos.title: Mannat's Challenge to Malla
videos.overview: Mannat challenges Malla that she will attend the Hariyali Teej Puja, and Vikrant will be the one to break her fast. What will Malla do?

videos.title: Vikrant Breaks Mannat's Fast
videos.overview: During Hariyali Teej, Vikrant breaks Mannat's fast in a divine moment, marking her Teej a success. Meanwhile, Malla learns Aish had donated her liver to Shruti.

videos.title: Malla Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Malla is shocked to learn that Mannat is Aish’s biological daughter and Aish is actually Sonia Khanna.

videos.title: Mannat and Malla's Face Off
videos.overview: Malla attacks Mannat and orders her to leave the mansion after learning they are half-sisters. However, Mannat vows to stay and win Vikrant back, at any cost.

videos.title: Mannat and Vikrant In Trouble!
videos.overview: Mezbani hosts a charity event where Mannat and Vikrant serve food happily. Malla secretly poisons the flour, making the kids sick and leaving everyone in shock.

videos.title: Mannat is Arrested
videos.overview: Following Malla and Puneet’s plan, police and a food officer raid Mezbani. Mannat is taken into custody after poisoned flour is found.

videos.title: Malla, Aish Warn Mannat
videos.overview: Malla and Aish threaten Mannat to sign the papers and return everything to Aish. They warn her that they will kill Shruti.

videos.title: Aniruddh Helps Mannat Expose Malla
videos.overview: Aniruddh proves Mannat’s innocence by exposing Malla’s act. Mannat reveals the truth to Vikrant and the family, clearing her name.

videos.title: Malla’s Suicide Shocks The Family
videos.overview: Malla's family turns against her. To gain sympathy and stop Vikrant from leaving, she attempts suicide.

videos.title: Mannat Doubts Malla’s Actions
videos.overview: The audience learns Malla faked taking sleeping pills with Aish's help. Mannat grows suspicious and begins plotting to gather proof and expose the truth.

videos.title: Mannat's Mission to Expose Malla
videos.overview: Mannat finds Malla’s sleeping pills untouched in the pipe and realises the truth. She’s now determined to expose Malla’s lie to Vikrant.

videos.title: Vikrant Demands a Divorce
videos.overview: Mannat exposes Malla for never taking the pills. Shocked by the betrayal, Vikrant is devastated and demands a divorce.

videos.title: Is Mannat In Danger?
videos.overview: Malla plots a deadly attack on Mannat at Mezbani. Meanwhile, Aish meets Anirudh, and their actual connection to Mannat is revealed!

videos.title: Aish Saves Mannat
videos.overview: Aish learns of Malla’s plan to ruin Mannat and arrives at Mezbani just in time to save her from the attack.

videos.title: Malla’s Shocking Reveal
videos.overview: Malla reveals to the family that Mannat is caring for Aish, who once saved her because Mannat is actually Aish's illegitimate daughter, leaving all in shock.

videos.title: Aish Reveals Mannat’s Truth
videos.overview: In front of the family, Aish reveals the painful truth that Mannat was born from a sexual assault by Anirudh Saxena during her college years.

videos.title: Mannat’s Shocking Truth
videos.overview: Mannat learns the man who proved her innocence is her real father. Aish calls him a criminal, and Anirudh is shattered seeing Mannat’s disgust for him.

videos.title: Mannat’s Bold Stand Against Anirudh
videos.overview: Mannat calls Anirudh a criminal and throws him out. Feeling guilty over Aish’s troubles, she’s comforted and supported firmly by Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat is Determined to Get Justice
videos.overview: Mannat is resolute about filing a police complaint against Anirudh, but Aish declines, expressing that she does not want to revisit those painful memories.

videos.title: Vikrant's Gift For Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant gifts Mannat a pendant, urging her to wear it during the Janmashtami Puja as a commitment. Malla resolves to stop Vikrant from going through with the divorce.

videos.title: Vikrant, Mannat Celebrate Janmashtami
videos.overview: Malla’s attempt to win Vikrant’s love by lip-syncing a Bhajan backfires. Mannat takes control of the situation and completes the Janmashtami Pooja with Vikrant.

videos.title: Aish is Kidnapped
videos.overview: Amidst the Janmashtami Aarti, Anirudh abducts Aish and plans to kill her in Mezbani. Vikrant and Mannat race against time to rescue her.

videos.title: Aish's Truth is Out
videos.overview: Aish tells Anirudh that she lied to everyone that he forced himself on her. Unaware of the truth, Mannat and Vikrant try to reach Aish to save her from Anirudh.

videos.title: Anirudh is Arrested
videos.overview: Aish is about to kill Anirudh, but Mannat and Vikrant reach Mezbani. Anirudh gets arrested but he tries to tell Mannat that he is innocent.

videos.title: Mannat Takes a Decision
videos.overview: Mannat decides to file a case against Anirudh, to hold him accountable for his crimes. While Aish signs the legal documents, she secretly ploys to kill Anirudh.

videos.title: Vikrant Supports Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant proudly supports Mannat’s fight for justice. Later, he jokes about jumping after winning Dahi-Handi if she won’t wear his necklace, but Malla overhears and plots to kill him.

videos.title: Malla’s Deadly Dahi-handi Plot
videos.overview: Amidst the Dahi-Handi celebrations, Malla removes all the wires and hinges from the crane to kill Vikrant. This creates a serious threat to Vikrant’s life.

videos.title: Vikrant's Life In Danger
videos.overview: Vikrant beams with joy as Mannat wears the necklace. Malla has sabotaged the crane, turning the vibrant Dahi-Handi celebration into a life-threatening spectacle.

videos.title: Mannat Fears For Vikrant’s Safety
videos.overview: Aish attacks Anirudh, but he escapes to protect Mannat and Vikrant. Malla warns about the safety harness as Vikrant climbs the crane, while Mannat prays in fear.

videos.title: Anirudh Saves The Day
videos.overview: Anirudh saves Mannat and Vikrant during Dahi-Handi but is arrested after Vikrant suspects him. He warns Mannat that Aish is lying and they’re in danger.

videos.title: Mannat Suspects Aish's Secrets
videos.overview: Mannat begins to suspect that Anirudh may be innocent. She also starts to believe that Aish is hiding the truth about her very existence.

videos.title: Vikrant Stands Firm For Mannat
videos.overview: Neetu blames Mannat and her biological father for the Dahi-Handi incident and tells her to leave the house and stay away from Vikrant. But Vikrant firmly declares that if Mannat leaves, he will leave too.

videos.title: Mannat Gets a Clue
videos.overview: Mannat reviews the Dahi-Handi CCTV footage and discovers it was a fair-skinned woman, not Anirudh, who tampered with the hinges.

videos.title: Mannat Meets Anirudh
videos.overview: Mannat meets Anirudh in jail and learns the truth about his past with Aishwarya.

videos.title: Mannat's Resolution
videos.overview: Mannat, influenced by Anirudh’s words, seeks Aish’s truth. She moves closer to Vikrant, certain Aish will react if he distances himself from Malla.

videos.title: Mannat Traps Aish
videos.overview: Amid Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations, Aish enters the prison to kill Anirudh but instead falls into Mannat’s trap, revealing Aish’s true intentions.

videos.title: Mannat Learns The Truth
videos.overview: As Aish tries to harm Anirudh, Mannat rushes to jail, rescues him, and learns the truth—Aish fabricated the assault story and she was not born out of rape.

videos.title: Mannat Exposes Aish
videos.overview: Mannat exposes Aish’s lies before Vikrant and the entire family, leaving everyone completely shocked.

videos.title: Mannat Exposes Aish’s Manipulation
videos.overview: Aish claims the video is fake and says she acted only to save Malla from Anirudh’s kidnapping, but Mannat insists she is manipulating everyone and stands her ground.

videos.title: Mannat Stands Her Ground
videos.overview: Mannat stands firm, accusing Aish of plotting Malla’s kidnapping, while Aish rejoices as the family trusts her lies and Malla’s divorce faces delay.

videos.title: A Rift Between Vikrant and Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat seeks Varun’s help to reach Malla, causing a rift with Vikrant. Meanwhile, Aish celebrates as her plan works and the Vikrant–Malla divorce is put on hold.

videos.title: Mannat Gets a Clue
videos.overview: Mannat finds Malla’s abduction site and records a video exposing Aish’s plot to kidnap Malla and frame Anirudh.

videos.title: Mannat In Trouble
videos.overview: Malla traps Mannat in a locked room with goons, but Aish scolds her for risking the staged kidnapping. Aish then spots Rajinder, who has uncovered the truth.

videos.title: Mannat Plots Daring Escape
videos.overview: Locked up, Mannat spots Rajinder and realises he knows Aish’s truth. She tries to escape through the window before Aish can manipulate him further.

videos.title: Aish Kills Rajinder
videos.overview: Aish kills Rajinder, but before Mannat can tell Vikrant, Malla twists the story, claiming Varun killed Rajinder while he and Aish were rescuing her.

videos.title: Mannat Determined to Expose Aish
videos.overview: Mannat tries to convince the family that Aish killed Rajinder, but they are deceived. Doubted yet determined, she vows to do whatever it takes for justice.

videos.title: Mannat Stands By Anirudh
videos.overview: Anirudh is ready to plead guilty, but Mannat urges him to fight. Aish retaliates by attacking Mannat publicly, only for Vikrant to save her.

videos.title: Mannat Activates Her Plan
videos.overview: Malla informs Mannat that she lacks evidence to prove Anirudh's innocence. Mannat then plans to get Malla to confess the truth for court.

videos.title: Mannat Tricks Malla
videos.overview: Mannat fakes ghostly events to make Malla confess to Rajinder’s death. Aish warns Malla of the trap and secretly plots revenge by planning an attack on Shruti.

videos.title: Malla Confesses The Truth
videos.overview: Mannat triumphs as Malla publicly admits that she and Aish were responsible for Rajinder’s death.

videos.title: Aish Uses Manipulation
videos.overview: Aish manipulates events, leading Vikrant to demand that Mannat apologise to Malla. She refuses, and later Vikrant overhears Malla and Aish, uncovering the full truth.

videos.title: Mannat, Vikrant Join Hands
videos.overview: Vikrant tells Mannat that he overheard Aish and Malla’s conversation and knows the full truth. He vows to support her and fight for justice for Anirudh.

videos.title: Mannat’s Trap For Aish
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant set a trap to make Aish confess, unaware that Aish is secretly plotting to kill Mannat. Danger lurks as their plan unfolds.

videos.title: Dhairya Saves Mannat In Time
videos.overview: Mannat faces Aish’s goons alone, but DCP Dhairya rescues her just in time. Vikrant arrives late and apologises for failing to protect her.

videos.title: Dcp Dhairya Supports Mannat
videos.overview: DCP Dhairya supports Mannat in court and secures more time to investigate. He plans to move Anirudh to safety as Aish plots his murder.

videos.title: Mannat Thwarts Malla’s Attack
videos.overview: During Ganesh Visarjan, Mannat discovers Malla’s plan to attack Anirudh. With Vikrant’s help, she saves him at the police station just in time.

videos.title: Mannat Tells Vikrant The Truth
videos.overview: Vikrant discovers from Mannat that Malla lied about their physical relationship to manipulate him. She orchestrated events to force a marriage and secure her place in his life.

videos.title: Mannat Activates Her Plan
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant vow to expose Aish’s misdeeds during Navratri. They plan to gather secret evidence and confront her publicly to reveal the truth to everyone.

videos.title: Mannat, Vikrant Celebrate Navratri
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant celebrate Navratri while secretly working on their plan. As Anirudh enters in disguise, their mission to make Aish confess her crimes progresses.

videos.title: Aish is Trapped By Mannat
videos.overview: Following Mannat's plan, Anirudh forces Aish into a secluded spot to confess her crimes at gunpoint. Meanwhile, Mannat panics, noticing the cameras are off and Vikrant's delay.

videos.title: Aish's Truth is Out In The Open
videos.overview: Mannat’s plan succeeds as Vikrant links the cameras to the projector, shocking the family with Aish’s truth and proving Mannat was right all along.

videos.title: Aish is Arrested
videos.overview: Dhairya arrests Aish for her crimes, and Gagan apologises to Mannat. Meanwhile, Neetu warns Ronny that Aish will reveal Vikrant’s past if he separates from Malla.

videos.title: Aish Blackmails Ronny
videos.overview: Vikrant and Mannat oppose Ronny for bailing out Malla, but it’s revealed Aish blackmailed him, threatening to expose Vikrant’s childhood past.

videos.title: Malla Signs The Divorce Papers
videos.overview: Vikrant allows Malla to stay in Saluja Mansion only if she signs the divorce papers, leaving her with no choice but to comply.

videos.title: Vikrant's Proposal For Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant proposes to Mannat and she agrees, but Neetu opposes it. Vikrant stands firm and tries to convince her of his decision.

videos.title: Vikrant, Mannat's Roka Ceremony
videos.overview: Vikrant convinces Neetu for the Roka, but her disapproval is clear. Mannat vows to win her over, while Malla schemes to ruin the relationship claiming her place as Vikrant’s wife.

videos.title: Dhairya Uncovers Vikrant is Aman
videos.overview: During Vikrant and Mannat's Roka ceremony, Dhairya meets Neetu and discovers that Vikrant is actually his long-lost younger brother, Aman.

videos.title: Threat to Vikrant and Mannat!
videos.overview: Vikrant asks Mannat on a date, but she teases him. Meanwhile, Malla plots against them, and Dhairya plans to teach Neetu and Ronny a lesson to reunite Vikrant with his family.

videos.title: Mannat, Vikrant’s Romantic Date
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant enjoy their date, unaware that Malla has set an oven blast to ruin their evening and snatch everything from Mannat. What will happen to Mannat and Vikrant?

videos.title: Vikrant Saves Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat brings a cake for Vikrant when the oven explodes, injuring him. Neetu calls Mannat a bad omen, but Vikrant stands by her. How will Mannat react?

videos.title: Dhairya’s Plan to Enter Mansion
videos.overview: Dhairya fakes saving Neetu and injures himself. Neetu takes him home for treatment, and at Vikrant’s request he stays, revealing his plan to enter Saluja mansion.

videos.title: Mannat's Surprise For Vikrant
videos.overview: Mannat plans Vikrant’s birthday surprise, But Dhairya’s voice note mentioning Aman triggers Vikrant’s panic attack, making Dhairya realise he holds memories of Aman.

videos.title: Threat On Vikrant
videos.overview: On Vikrant’s birthday, Neetu arranges a pooja, but during the hawan, the fire flares up, and the pandit deems their bond inauspicious. Malla orchestrates this and plans Vikrant's accident.

videos.title: Vikrant Apologises to Mannat
videos.overview: Neetu insults Mannat and cancels her wedding with Vikrant, ignoring his defense. Later, Vikrant sincerely apologises to Mannat and comforts her.

videos.title: Vishakha Feeds Kheer to Vikrant
videos.overview: During Vikrant’s birthday celebration, Vishakha disguised as a cleaner makes him eat the Kheer she prepared. Neetu spots her, gets terrified, and suffers a panic attack.

videos.title: Mannat Finds Vishakha
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant seek Dhairya’s help to find Vishakha, who fed Vikrant the Kheer. Though he finds no clues, Mannat later discovers CCTV footage revealing Vishakha.

videos.title: Mannat, Vikrant to Meet Vishakha
videos.overview: Mannat tells Vikrant about the mysterious Vishakha, and together they plan to meet her to safeguard their family.

videos.title: Vishakha Reveals She is Vikrant’s Mother
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant meet Vishakha, where she shocks them by revealing that she is Vikrant’s biological mother.

videos.title: Vishakha Manipulates Vikrant and Mannat
videos.overview: Vishakha tricks Vikrant and Mannat by faking a terminal illness and posing as Vikrant’s surrogate. Her arrival at their engagement shocks Neetu and Ronny.

videos.title: Vikrant's Firm Decision
videos.overview: Vikrant learns from Ronny that Vishakha is his mother and lets her stay at the Saluja Mansion. But Mannat grows suspicious, sensing Vishakha is hiding a deeper secret.

videos.title: Mannat Doubts Vishakha’s Motives
videos.overview: Mannat suspects Vishakha’s motives after meeting her, while it’s revealed she once sold her own son Aman to Ronny for ₹50 lakhs, showing her greed and manipulation.

videos.title: Mannat Questions Vishakha
videos.overview: Gagan supports Mannat as she questions Vishakha about her whereabouts. Meanwhile, when Neetu suffers a panic attack, Vikrant firmly tells Vishakha nothing comes before his mother.

videos.title: Mannat Stands Firm Against Vishakha
videos.overview: Mannat overhears Vishakha turning Vikrant against Neetu and warns she’ll protect him and the family. Seeing her as a threat, Vishakha plots to separate them forever.

videos.title: Mannat and Vikrant Face a Rift
videos.overview: Vishakha turns Vikrant against Shruti, causing a rift with Mannat. Eventually, Vikrant realizes his mistake and reconciles with both Shruti and Mannat.

videos.title: Fallout Between Vikrant and Mannat
videos.overview: During Karwachauth, Neetu slaps Shruti, sparking a fight between Vikrant and Mannat. As tensions rise and they defend their mothers, Vikrant calls off the wedding in anger.

videos.title: Vikrant and Mannat's Divine Wedding
videos.overview: Vikrant learns from Ronny that Neetu slapped Shruti. Realizing the truth, he apologizes to Mannat, and in a divine turn of events, they get married.

videos.title: Vikrant Teases Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant teases Mannat by calling her Mrs. Vikrant Saluja, while Aish blackmails Dhairya, forcing him to help her escape so she can seek revenge on Mannat.

videos.title: Mannat Confronts Dhairya
videos.overview: Mannat confronts Dhairya for transferring Aish to the hospital. Dhairya reveals Aish knows a secret from his past. Mannat and Vikrant team up to uncover Aish’s leverage over him.

videos.title: Vikrant Returns Necklace to Neetu
videos.overview: Mannat secretly adds itching powder to the necklace Vishakha snatched from Neetu. At the Sangeet, Vishakha throws it away and Vikrant returns it, defending his mother’s honor.

videos.title: Neetu Accepts Mannat
videos.overview: Neetu warmly accepts Mannat as her daughter-in-law, leaving Vikrant and Mannat emotional. Malla secretly records Dhairya and Vishakha, with plans to reveal Vikrant’s parentage.

videos.title: Mannat Learns About Malla's Plan
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant uncover Aish and Malla’s plan to expose a secret that could shatter the Salujas. However, they are unaware that the Vikrant is Vishakha’s biological son.

videos.title: Vikrant’s Secret is Revealed
videos.overview: Mannat discovers that Vikrant is actually Vishakha’s biological son. She also learns from Dhairya how Neetu and Ronny took him away, leaving her shocked by this long-hidden secret.

videos.title: Mannat Stops Dhairya
videos.overview: Mannat asks Dhairya to delay telling Vikrant about his real identity. She also confronts Ronny and Neetu, urging them to reveal the truth to him.

videos.title: Mannat's Request to Ronny
videos.overview: Mannat urges Ronny and Neetu to confess to Vikrant before it's too late. Ronny agrees and seeks Vishakha's permission for time to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Vishakha's Demand
videos.overview: Vishakha demands the entire Saluja property in exchange for giving Ronny time to confess the truth to Vikrant. What will happen next?

videos.title: Vikrant Stands By Neetu
videos.overview: Vishakha accuses Neetu of harming her, but Mannat cleverly proves Neetu’s innocence, earning Vikrant’s unwavering support and restoring peace.

videos.title: Malla and Vishakha’s Plan
videos.overview: Malla and Vishakha plan a skit to help revive Vikrant’s memories. Meanwhile, Vishakha’s apology to Neetu raises suspicion, as Mannat senses her hidden motive.

videos.title: Mannat Wins Ronny’s Trust
videos.overview: Mannat stops Ronny from transferring the property to Vishakha, earning his praise. Meanwhile, Vishakha and Malla plan a skit to trigger Vikrant’s childhood memories.

videos.title: Mannat Trapped By Malla
videos.overview: As Malla and Vishakha prepare for the skit, Mannat learns of their plan and vows to stop them. Malla attacks her and orders goons to lock her inside a box.

videos.title: Will Vikrant Recall His Past?
videos.overview: Malla and Vishakha’s skit triggers Vikrant’s hazy childhood memories, leading to a panic attack hinting at his past. Meanwhile, trapped Mannat struggles to escape the box.

videos.title: Mannat Faces Malla and Vishakha
videos.overview: Mannat confronts Malla and Vishakha over the skit plans. She urges Ronny and Neetu to confess to Vikrant, warning that any delay will allow Vishakha to manipulate him further.

videos.title: Neetu Threatens Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat wants to reveal the truth about Vikrant’s childhood and Vishakha. Neetu threatens to take her own life if Mannat dares to speak.

videos.title: Mannat Decides to Tell The Truth
videos.overview: Mannat plans to reveal Vikrant’s birth truth after Lakshmi Pooja, but Malla learns he recalls his past and urges Vishakha to expose it before Mannat gets the chance.

videos.title: Mannat Saves Dhairya’s Dadi
videos.overview: Mannat rescues an elderly woman at the old age home, unaware she’s Dhairya’s Dadi, while Vishakha tricks Neetu into confessing her sins as Malla records everything.

videos.title: Dadi Reveals Vishakha's Truth
videos.overview: Dadi exposes Vishakha’s secret that she sold Aman to Ronny, leaving Mannat and Dhairya utterly shocked and heartbroken by the revelation.

videos.title: Will Vishakha Confess Her Sins?
videos.overview: Dhairya is shattered after learning Vishakha’s truth, while Mannat plans a way to make Vishakha confess her sins and reveal everything.

videos.title: Mannat’s Ultimatum to Vishaka
videos.overview: Mannat gives Vishakha two choices: go to jail or leave Saluja Mansion forever without revealing anything to Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat’s Moment Of Victory
videos.overview: Mannat wins as Vishakha accepts her condition and leaves Saluja Mansion for good. Later, Ronny, Neetu, and Mannat share an emotional heartfelt moment together.

videos.title: Aish’s Plot For Revenge
videos.overview: With Aish’s help, Vishakha manipulates Dhairya into staying at Saluja Mansion till Mannat and Vikrant’s wedding. Meanwhile, Aish plots revenge and plans her escape from jail.

videos.title: Aish's Plan to Escape
videos.overview: Dhairya tells Mannat and Vikrant that Aish has escaped from the hospital. As they search for her, Mannat finally comes face to face with Aish in the children's ward.

videos.title: Aish is Pronounced Dead
videos.overview: Aish attacks Mannat. To protect Mannat, Dhairya shoots Aish. Later, the doctor arrives and declares Aish dead.

videos.title: Aish Comes Back to Life!
videos.overview: Mannat feels guilty about Aish’s death. However, she is stunned when Malla and Vishakha revive Aish and reveal that the tragedy was a planned one.

videos.title: Aish Enters Saluja Mansion
videos.overview: Aish returns to the Saluja Mansion disguised as a maid named Asma. She plans to create trouble for Mannat and the Saluja family.

videos.title: Malla Secretly Follows Mannat
videos.overview: Aish hurts Vishakha to cause a rift between Neetu and Vikrant. Meanwhile, Mannat goes to give lunch to Dadi and is secretly followed by Malla.

videos.title: Aish's Next Move
videos.overview: With Mannat’s help, Aish secures her job at Saluja Mansion. Later, she plans her next move to expose Neetu for drugging Vikrant during the Haldi celebrations.

videos.title: Mannat, Vikrant's Haldi Ceremony
videos.overview: During Mannat and Vikrant’s Haldi, Aish and Malla plant the Neetu–Ronny confession video in Vikrant’s room and slip the memory-suppressing pills into Neetu’s purse.

videos.title: Vikrant Confronts Mannat In Anger
videos.overview: Antidepressants fall from Neetu’s purse and she lies that they were for her, hiding that she gave them to Vikrant. Vikrant learns Mannat knew about this and angrily confronts her.

videos.title: Vikrant Seeks Forgiveness From Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant apologizes to Mannat for his mistake, while Aish, Malla, and Vishakha plan to reach Dadi through Dhairya during Mannat’s Choodha ceremony.

videos.title: Mannat Saves The Day
videos.overview: Mannat realizes that Vishakha has tricked Dhairya into meeting Dadi and she saves the day by stopping him before the plan unfolds, leaving Vishakha frustrated and exposed.

videos.title: Dhairya Bids Adieu to Mannat
videos.overview: Dhairya blesses Mannat before her wedding. Meanwhile, Vik finds the envelope, and Aish celebrates, knowing Vik’s true identity will soon be revealed.

videos.title: Mannat Halts Rituals and Love Begins
videos.overview: Mannat locks Vishakha in the washroom and stops Dhairya from the wedding. As the chaos settles, Mannat and Vikrant share a tender moment, ready to begin their new life together.

videos.title: The Wedding Begins
videos.overview: As Mannat and Vikrant’s wedding rituals begin, Aish makes sure the projector and envelope reach Vikrant at the Mandap, setting up the moment that will reveal he is Vishakha’s son.

videos.title: Keerat Reveals The Truth
videos.overview: Amidst the Pheras, Keerat switches on the projector and Vikrant is stunned as he learns he is not Ronny and Neetu's son, shattering everything he believed.

videos.title: Vishakha’s Hidden Scheme
videos.overview: Vikrant doesn’t believe Vishakha at first. Later, she tricks him, creating tension with Mannat as her manipulation twists the truth and sows doubt in him.

videos.title: Vikrant Demands Proof
videos.overview: Vishakha turns Vikrant against Mannat, but Mannat accuses her of lying. Vikrant demands proof, pushing Mannat to leave and bring Dadi as evidence.

videos.title: Mannat's Race For Proof
videos.overview: Ronny urges Vikrant not to trust Vishakha. Elsewhere, Mannat goes to bring Dadi to prove she is not lying, but Aishwarya captures Dadi before Mannat reaches.

videos.title: Vikrant Disbelieves Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat brings Dadi's lifeless body, shocking the Saluja family. Later, Dhairya exposes Vishakha's manipulation, but Vikrant steps back, asking for time before marrying Mannat.

videos.title: Mannat Finds a Witness
videos.overview: Mannat sees Matron as the key to exposing Vishakha to Vikrant. Meanwhile, Vikrant regrets his outburst at Mannat and decides to hear her side of the story.

videos.title: Vikrant's Faith In Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant stands by Mannat despite Vishakha's manipulation, while Mannat and Dhairya gather proof of her crimes. Later, Aish deliberately hits Vishakha with a car to frame Neetu.

videos.title: Neetu's Desperate Attempt
videos.overview: Vikrant tells Dhairya that Neetu caused Vishaka's accident, while Neetu attempts suicide. Later, Vikrant apologises to Vishaka for not trusting her, unaware of her fake emotions.

videos.title: Vikrant Suspects Neetu
videos.overview: Vishakha manipulates Vikrant about Mannat, leading him to confront Dhairya as Mannat tries to calm things. Later, Vikrant claims Neetu planned to kill Vishakha.

videos.title: Mannat, Vikrant's Heated Clash
videos.overview: The conflict rises between Vikrant and Mannat as they fight about Vishaka and Neetu. Later, seeing their fight, Neetu breaks down and agrees to his accusations.

videos.title: Vishakha Fumes At Ronny
videos.overview: Vishakha engages in a heated argument with Ronny and Neetu. Later, Dhairya apologises to Vikrant for choosing the difficult truth over an easy lie.

videos.title: Neetu's Shocking Arrest
videos.overview: Devastated by Vikrant's accusations, Neetu urges Dhairya to sign the arrest warrant. Later, Vishakha and Aish feel happy as their plan succeeds and Neetu gets arrested

videos.title: Vikrant Doubts Mannat's Love
videos.overview: Vikrant confronts Mannat for valuing Dhairya above him. Later, Neetu regrets hiding the truth from Vikrant, and Ronny reassures her that he will always stand by her side.

videos.title: Ronny's Plea to Vikrant
videos.overview: Ronny falls at Vikrant's feet, pleading with him to withdraw the case against Neetu. Later, he agrees to Vikrant's condition to sign over his property, sparking chaos.

videos.title: Gagan's Advice to Vikrant
videos.overview: Gagan tries to explain to Vikrant the importance of Neetu and Ronny in his life. Later, Ronny and Mannat sign the property papers in Vikrant's name.

videos.title: Vikrant Breaks Ties With Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat tells Vikrant he will bear the lifelong burden of throwing Ronny and Neetu out of the house. She bitterly congratulates Vikrant for breaking their relationship.

videos.title: Is Mannat Pregnant?
videos.overview: Vikrant checks on Neetu as Mannat feels distressed thinking of Vikrant. Later, tension arises when the doctor tells Mannat she may be pregnant and advises a medical check-up.

videos.title: Dhairya Gives Mannat Hope
videos.overview: Dhairya assures Mannat that the news of her pregnancy will help mend things with Vikrant. Later, Malla learns of Mannat's pregnancy and informs Aish and Vishakha.

videos.title: Mannat Slaps Vikrant
videos.overview: Mannat hits Vikrant when he accuses her of having an affair with Dhairya, leading to a heated clash. Later, Vishakha, Aish, and Malla celebrate Mannat and Vikrant's conflict.

videos.title: Shruti's Escape From Sonia

videos.title: Dua's Life in Danger
videos.overview: Vikrant confides in Mannat about his unexplained bond with Dua. Tensions rise as Arzoo seizes Dua and pushes her off a cliff before fleeing, leaving everyone devastated.

videos.title: Arzoo Faces Mannat's Wrath
videos.overview: Vikrant and Dhairya team up to save Mannat and Dua from a cliff. Later, Mannat stops Arzoo's car and confronts her to avenge Shruti's death.

videos.title: Vishakha Drops the Bombshell
videos.overview: Malla and Yashika fear Vikrant and Mannat's wrath after Arzoo's death. Meanwhile, Vishakha exposes Yashika's role in Dua's kidnapping, leaving Vikrant and Mannat shocked.

videos.title: Mannat's Reunion Plan
videos.overview: Vikrant recalls his actions against Neetu and Ronny and regrets about it. Mannat decides to reunite Vikrant with them after seeing his regret.

videos.title: Vikrant Seeks Forgiveness
videos.overview: Vikrant apologises to Ronny, expressing regret for his actions. Mannat confides in Dhairya that she will hide the truth that Vikrant is Dua's father.

videos.title: Ronny's Advice to Mannat
videos.overview: Neetu promises Ronny to keep Dua's identity secret from Vikrant. Ronny advises Mannat on life and relationships, urging her to remove herself from Vikrant's life for peace.

videos.title: Dhairya's Ultimatum to Vikrant
videos.overview: Dhairya warns Vikrant not to interfere between him and Mannat. Malla tells Yashika to leave, declaring that Vikrant's heart still belongs to Mannat.

videos.title: Vikrant, Neetu's Emotional Reunion
videos.overview: Neetu and Ronny are overwhelmed with memories as they enter the Saluja mansion. Vikrant, filled with regret, apologises to Neetu, leading to a heartfelt reunion.

videos.title: Yashika's Deadly Move
videos.overview: At Baisakhi, Yashika secretly sets hay ablaze and pushes Mannat into the fire. Vikrant risks his life, leaping into the flames to save her.

videos.title: Neetu's Secret Plan
videos.overview: Mannat tends to Vikrant's wounds. Neetu vows to expose Dua's truth before Vikrant, prompting Dhairya to grow suspicious of her plan for Dua's DNA test.

videos.title: Dhairya Fears Losing Dua
videos.overview: Tension rises as Neetu suddenly collapses, while Yashika suspects that Neetu is hiding a secret. Dhairya fears losing Dua if Vikrant learns that she is his daughter.

videos.title: Vikrant Discovers Dua's Truth
videos.overview: Vikrant is stunned to learn that Dua is his daughter, while Mannat uncovers Neetu's plot to ensure Vikrant learns it. Dua requests Vikrant to accompany her home.

videos.title: Neetu Vows to Reunite the Family
videos.overview: Neetu vows to reunite Mannat, Vikrant, and Dua. Moments later, Mannat warns Vikrant that he has no right over Dua, as he abandoned her and their family in the past.

videos.title: Dua's Emotional Confession
videos.overview: Neetu strongly urges Vikrant to fight for his rights over Dua as his daughter. Later, an emotional Dua tearfully opens up to Vikrant about her deep bond with Dhairya.

videos.title: Vikrant's Plea to Dhairya
videos.overview: Vikrant pleads with Dhairya for a chance to watch Dua grow from afar. Mannat kindly asks Vikrant to stay away and let them live independently.

videos.title: A Shock for Dhairya
videos.overview: Ronny guides Mannat as she faces a dilemma over choosing Vikrant or Dhairya as Dua's father. Mannat shocks Dhairya by revealing that Vikrant has filed for Dua's custody.

videos.title: Dhairya Doubts Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat is shaken to learn that Vikrant has filed for Dua's custody, sparking tension at home. While Neetu defends Vikrant, Dhairya grows furious and doubts Mannat's intentions.

videos.title: Yashika's Secret Plot
videos.overview: Vikrant opens up to Yashika about the custody case, but her hidden agenda begins to influence him. As Mannat lashes out and vows to keep Dua, tensions escalate within the family.
